plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-17 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row of this map, including every printed term total. The 2026-2027 catalog year is taken from the map heading ('Political Science map for 2026-2027') and the program page's 2026-2027 catalog-year selection. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The map's printed disclaimer reads verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.' General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. This extraction did not capture per-course prerequisite text, so no prereqs are recorded. This plan transcribes the only 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Political Science / Associate in Arts for Transfer / 60-67 units / 4 terms / to CSU' (PROGRAM 1/1). The map contains only the Bakersfield College segment; no CSU courses or terms are listed, so none are transcribed. The map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-16.5 / 15-18 / 15-16 and a plan total of 60-67 units. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Statistics' (4-4.5) and 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4); Term 3 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4) and 'Area 5A : Physical Sciences' (3-5); Term 4 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. This map names no individual courses: every row is a 'Choose a course from ...' slot, transcribed as printed. The three 'Major Core Courses' slots (Terms 1-3) are printed with the labels 'Major / Gen Ed' (Term 1) and 'Major' (Terms 2-3) and are recorded as major choice slots (codes BC-CORE-1, BC-CORE-2, BC-CORE-3). The 'Statistics' slot is printed with the label 'Major / Gen Ed' and is recorded as a major choice slot (code BC-STAT-1). The two 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' slots (Terms 3 and 4) are recorded as BC-A4-1 and BC-A4-2.
